mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_log ( id, request_id, operation_type, operation_detail, latency_ms, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, model_name, status, error_code, error_reason, create_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{requestId}, #{operationType}, CAST(#{operationDetail} AS jsonb), #{latencyMs}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{modelName}, #{status}, #{errorCode}, #{errorReason}, #{createTime} )
